article.title: Emptying West Bank refugee camps may be a war crime: UN
article.summary: GENEVA: The United Nations warned on Friday that Israel’s forced displacement of the entire Palestinian populations of three West Bank refugee camps last year could amount to crimes against humanity.The UN rights office described how a military operation launched in the north of the occupied territory in January 2025 had forcibly displaced over 33,000 people.At the start of operation “Iron Wall”, Israeli military, police and other forces entered the camps and killed civilians, destroyed hundreds of homes and damaged infrastructure, it said.They cut off water and electricity and barred humanitarian access to the camps before going door to door forcing residents to leave, it added.Israel’s actions raise concerns of ethnic cleansing, says UN rights office; two Israeli ministers seek removal of Palestinians from GazaA few days into the operation, Israeli security forces “consolidated their control” over the camps and “forcibly displaced their population in their entirety”, the report sa...

article.title: US ambassador to Israel calls for 'severe consequences' to stop West Bank violence
article.summary: US ambassador to Israel calls for 'severe consequences' to stop West Bank violenceThe US ambassador to Israel has called for "severe consequences" to stop violence in the occupied West Bank, as he met with Palestinians who have suffered from Israeli settler violence.Mike Huckabee visited the Palestinian town of Turmus Ayya, which has been the target of repeated settler attacks, and spoke ‌with families of US citizens killed by Israeli settlers and soldiers."Our clear message is that crime is crime, terror is terror. When people do it, they should have an expectation that they will have severe consequences," Huckabee told reporters, but he declined to criticise Israel."The Israeli government must guarantee the safety and security of the population in the West Bank," he said.He said that he had visited the West Bank town, which has a large US-Palestinian population, "to understand the situation on the ground".

article.title: Israel's West Bank camp displacements could be crime against humanity, UN says
article.summary: The Israeli government's forced displacement of the entire populations of three West Bank refugee camps in January 2025 could amount to crimes against humanity, a UN report warned Friday. More than 33,000 Palestinians forced out of the Jenin, Nur Shams and Tulkarm camps have not been permitted to return home. Israel slammed the report for "spreading misinformation".
